extension.name: System - Ceebl RSForm CSV Export
extension.license: GNU General Public License version 2 or later
extension.description: Excel UTF-8 CSV compatibility and configurable access control for RSForm! Pro directory exports.

field.name: enable_encoding_fix
field.label: Enable Excel UTF-8 Fix
field.description: Improve Excel compatibility for UTF-8 CSV exports.

field.name: restrict_downloads
field.label: Restrict CSV Downloads
field.description: Allow CSV downloads only for users in selected Joomla groups.

field.name: allowed_groups
field.label: Allowed User Groups
field.description: Select groups allowed to download CSV files when restrictions are enabled. No selected groups means no access.

field.name: hide_export_buttons
field.label: Hide Export Buttons
field.description: Hide CSV export buttons from users without download permission when restrictions are enabled.
